comment: Ground truth. Every defect in this app is here, on purpose, with the page it
lives on and the clause it breaks. Tests assert the crawl finds exactly this
set — no misses and no extras. An undocumented finding is a false positive;
a documented one that goes unfound is a regression. An actual bug in the app
that is not listed here is a bug in the app, not a discovery.

expected.why: The Admin link is rendered for every role. The backend rejects the request, but the link itself is the exposure StateScout exists to catch.
A debug panel left in the production build.
A destructive control reachable by a guest, two clicks from the seed.
The skip-to-content link every other page carries is missing here. Exercises FR-19, which an intersection-only audit cannot express.

expected_graph.comment: States assume one role per run. A second role is a second run with its own graph.
